nodes.title: SG-10.2.3 Remove store-driven focus and unsubscribe on scene shutdown
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene.create registers a SHUTDOWN handler (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) that removes the keydown listener, unsubscribes from useGameStore, and destroys effects, scene objects and characters. It does not blur focused objects or reset gameStore.focusedObjectId. Desired behavior: on shutdown the focus is removed and the subscription is released. Expected result: after shutdown no scene object stays focused, the store focusedObjectId is null, and later store changes do not reach the scene. Why: a stale focus id would re-highlight objects when the scene restarts.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a focused object, when the scene shuts down, then the object is blurred and focusedObjectId is null.
- Given the scene has shut down, when the store changes, then onStateChange is not invoked and no object is focused.
- A unit test asserts both behaviors.


## Scope
- In scope: BootScene SHUTDOWN handler
- In scope: Unit test for shutdown focus removal
- Out of scope: Keyboard handler logic
- Out of scope: Store schema changes
- Out of scope: Backend
- Preserve: Existing shutdown cleanup of keyboard listener, effects, objects and characters
- Preserve: applyFocusedObject behavior


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90 APIs only
- Unit tests mock Phaser as in tests/bootSceneFocusClear.test.ts


## Definition of done
- Shutdown removes focus and unsubscribes
- Unit test passes


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Shutdown blurs focused scene objects and clears store focusedObjectId
nodes.body:
Context: the SHUTDOWN handler in BootScene.create leaves objects focused and the store id set. Desired behavior: blur every focused SceneObject and call useGameStore.getState().setFocusedObject(null) during shutdown. Expected result: no focus remains in scene or store. Why: avoid stale focus after the scene is torn down.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given bookshelf is focused in scene and store, when SHUTDOWN runs, then blur is called on it and focusedObjectId is null.
- Given nothing is focused, when SHUTDOWN runs, then focusedObjectId remains null and blur is not called.


## Scope
- In scope: BootScene SHUTDOWN handler focus removal
- Out of scope: Store changes
- Preserve: Other shutdown cleanup


## Technical constraints
- Use the existing setFocusedObject action


## Definition of done
- Shutdown clears scene and store focus


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Shutdown unsubscribes from the store so later changes do not reach the scene
nodes.body:
Context: the handler already calls this.unsubscribe, but ordering relative to the focus reset matters: the unsubscribe must run before setFocusedObject(null) so the reset does not trigger onStateChange on destroyed objects. Desired behavior: unsubscribe first, then clear focus. Expected result: onStateChange is not called after shutdown. Why: prevents calls on destroyed objects.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given shutdown has run, when setFocusedObject is called with an id, then no object focus or sync is invoked.
- Given shutdown, when focus is cleared, then onStateChange is not called by that update.


## Scope
- In scope: Ordering of unsubscribe and focus reset in the SHUTDOWN handler
- Out of scope: Subscription creation
- Preserve: unsubscribe set to null after shutdown


## Technical constraints
- Keep this.unsubscribe nullable field


## Definition of done
- Unsubscribe precedes the focus reset


## Clarifying questions
- None
